description: Parliament of Sri Lanka - Convening of Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Monday, 2nd February, 2015 at 2.00 p.m. by Mr. Speaker
reasoning: This gazette content specifically announces the convening of Parliament on a specific date and time at the request of the Prime Minister.
